definitions: a visually striking performance or display.
an event or scene regarded in terms of its visual impact.
a public show or display, especially one on a large scale.
a person or thing that is an object of curiosity or contempt.
glasses or eyeglasses (often used in the plural 'spectacles').
examples: The carnival was a magnificent spectacle.
He made a spectacle of himself.
She wore a pair of spectacles.
